description: Liste des lignes de bus et tramway is a dataset listed in Twisto-caen open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Twisto. Parcours des lignes de bus et tramway du réseau Twisto. Coverage: Caen la Mer (Twisto network). The portal files it under Bus et tramway. Its keywords are parcours, Bus, Tramway, Ligne, GTFS. The portal shows 67 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-08-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Domaine public (https://www.opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-twisto-fr-portal.
